summary: An Oak Alley-type Greek Revival mansion: a 44x20 white two-storey block on a red-brick base. Eight colossal 2x2 quartz columns carry a full-width double gallery, and one low slate hip with a dentil cornice, three front dormers and four brick chimneys covers both. A rear T-wing holds the vaulted living room and the open kitchen. It reads as a plantation house because of the oak allee drive, the colonnade, the parterre and fountain, the outbuildings and the river dock. plan.md is written; the roof heights are estimates and haven't been dry-run with `mcd roof` yet.
concept_subject: A grand antebellum Greek Revival plantation estate on a river, seen from the north. A straight gravel drive runs from white gate piers with lanterns at the road, under an allee of eight huge spreading live oaks whose dark crowns meet overhead and drip with Spanish moss, to an oval gravel forecourt around a lawn island with an urn. Behind it stands the mansion, broad and symmetrical: a brilliant white two-storey block on a red-brick raised base with arched iron vents. Across its whole front, eight colossal white fluted columns with Ionic capitals rise the full two storeys. They carry a deep double gallery: a white-floored ground porch reached by wide quartz steps, and an upper porch with white balustrades between the columns. A plain white entablature and a dentilled quartz cornice run above. Over everything sits one low, wide dark-slate hip roof with three white gabled dormers on the front, two on the back, and four red-brick chimneys with dark bands and stepped caps. Behind the columns, tall floor-length windows hang between near-black shutters. In the centre of each floor is a dark double door with glass sidelights and a transom in a white pillared surround. A slate-hipped rear wing with a tall arched Palladian window and a slim-columned back porch faces a lawn running down to a sandy bank, the brown-green river and a spruce landing dock with lanterns. To the west are a formal parterre of dark boxwood hedges, flower beds and cone topiaries around a white quartz fountain, a white-framed glass greenhouse on a brick dwarf wall, and an octagonal white gazebo with a dark pointed cap on the riverbank. To the east are a red-brick carriage house with white quoins, three arched carriage doors and a white lantern cupola on its slate hip, and a little white guest cottage with its own four-column porch under a slate hip. Pink cherry trees and magnolias dot the lawns, and lantern posts line every path.
concept_size: 96 x 96 estate; mansion 46 wide (with gallery) x 41 deep (with rear wing), 2 tall storeys + low hip roof, about 30 high
